title: 1. Your side
description: This side shows you a combat summary of you and your opponents' actions.

title: 2. Enemy side
description: This side shows the creature you fought. The Training Area creature is intentionally weak so you can learn the flow.

title: 3. Combat summary
description: The summary lists damage, healing, and ability usage.

title: 4. Open Essences
description: You just received an unbound Essence from winning the fight. Click Open Essences to absorb the Essence.
